name: jev.scrape-classify
description: Level 3 composite at scale: classify one scraped row (ByteGrad Jev+Playwright pattern).

category.instructions: What kind of content is this scraped item

criteria.product-listing: A product, price, plan, or marketplace listing
criteria.person-profile: A person, title, company, or contact block
criteria.job-posting: A job, role, opening, or listing with duties or pay
criteria.article: A blog post, news item, essay, or documentation page
criteria.forum-comment: A comment, review, reply, or user-generated opinion
criteria.navigation: Menu, footer, cookie banner, pagination, or other chrome
criteria.ad: Advertisement, sponsored block, or promotional insert

rules.reason: category confidence at or below 0.90: human or meta-router decides
no listed category fits: human or meta-router decides

notes.verdicts: PASS = row labelled with the chosen category (confidence above 0.90, not 'other'). ESCALATE = row goes to review. Caller drops navigation/ad/empty rows by category; the gate only judges label trust.
notes.bar: Required answer must be ABOVE 0.90; exactly 0.90 does not pass (work-criteria.json).
notes.changed: 2026-09-28: rules rewritten; prior rules referenced a missing question (compact-read), used unsupported choice<0.90 (triage, skill-router), or were absent (escalation, auto-approve, file-triage).
